rules.expected: Per-candidate frequency and connectivity validation is documented for the requested OCM and reaction-channel candidates. Apply to candidates retained for a scientific result; failed attempts or failed optional controls do not invalidate a separately validated main pathway. Complete status still requires the requested channel coverage.
Energy assembly, reference state, solvent and temperature are explicit and internally consistent.
Endo-OCM is supported as preferred in the modeled system and the requested barrier comparison is reported with scope.

notes: Scientific-result scoring only. Ordinary limitations/uncertainty prose is optional and unscored. Preserve all required identity, state, convergence, frequency/path, energy-definition and evidence checks. Score actual supported components; honest partial/failed submissions are valid but earn no unavailable result credit. Failed optional attempts do not invalidate completed primary work. Numeric screening alone does not validate chemistry or protocol comparability.
